Journey.Order.Title: Start with the order number.
Journey.Order.Subtitle: It names the files saved in this session, on disk and in the cloud.
Journey.Order.Help: Up to 64 characters. Windows does not allow \ / : * ? " < > | in file names, or a full stop at the end. Invisible characters from pasted text are removed. The number is not remembered after the app is closed.
Journey.Order.Invalid: This order number cannot be used as a file name. Remove characters such as \ / : * ? " < > | and any full stop at the end. Names that Windows reserves for devices, such as CON, NUL or COM1, cannot be used either, alone or before a full stop.
Journey.Order.NamesByTitle: No order number yet. Saved files keep the recording titles.
Journey.Order.NamesByOrder: One recording is saved as {0} plus the file extension, for example {0}.mkv. When more than one recording is saved under this order number in a session, the order number becomes a prefix: {0}_recording title.mkv.
Journey.Order.NamingHelp: The extension follows the format chosen in Preserve; a network recording kept unchanged takes the extension of the delivered stream. An existing file is never replaced; a number in brackets is added instead. Cloud uploads use the same names.
Journey.Order.SummaryNone: No order number set: files keep the recording titles. Enter one in step 00 to name files by order.
Journey.Order.SummarySingle: The file is named {0} plus its extension.
Journey.Order.SummarySeveral: Files are named {0}_recording title plus the extension.
Journey.Library.Title: Your recordings, rediscovered.
Journey.Library.Subtitle: Preview originals and select recordings to preserve.
Journey.Library.ConnectHelp: Connect a Panasonic recorder disk or open a complete disk image. The video files found there will appear here.
Journey.Library.SelectHelp: Select a file to inspect it, or select several to preserve together.
Journey.Library.ListAccessible: Source video files. Select one or more files for export.
Journey.Library.SelectPreserveHelp: Select one or more files to preserve.
Journey.Library.ProgrammesNotice: Recorder files can contain several programmes. Original filenames are shown; programmes are not split automatically.
Journey.Preview.Title: A moment before you preserve it
Journey.Preview.SelectHelp: Choose a recording, then open its preview or media details.
Journey.Preview.CacheNotice: The selected original is copied to a temporary local cache first. A preview keeps its original codecs; Windows playback support can vary.
Journey.Library.NoVideos: No recognized video files were found. Try another source, or check this recorder's format compatibility.
Journey.Library.NoMatches: No filenames match your search. Clear the search to see every recording.
Journey.Preview.SelectTarget: Select a recording to preview or inspect.
Journey.Preview.SelectSourceHelp: Choose one or more files from the list. The most recently selected file will be inspected.
Journey.Preview.PlaybackError: Windows could not play this video
Journey.Preview.PlaceholderHelp:
Up to 45 seconds. Original picture and sound.
Choose a file, then play a short preview.
Journey.Library.SourceRequired: Connect a source disk or image first.
Journey.Cache.UnsafeDelete: Refusing to remove a file outside this session's cache.
Journey.Media.Units: Inspected with MediaInfoLib. Duration is reported in seconds; sizes in bytes and bitrates in bits/second.
Journey.Preview.PlaybackErrorHelp: Windows may lack the required video or audio codec. You can still inspect and export the original streams. {0}
Journey.Preview.UnavailableHelp: Preview is unavailable on this Windows installation. Its media playback components or codecs may be missing. You can still browse, inspect and export the original video streams. {0}
Journey.Cache.SpaceRequired: There is not enough free space in {0}. At least {1} is needed for this step.
Journey.Media.Field.Title: Title
Journey.Export.Title: Keep every detail.
Journey.Export.Subtitle: Give your recordings a new home, with their original picture and sound.
Journey.Export.EmptyHelp: Choose one or more recordings in Discover. You'll select their format and destination here.
Journey.Export.FormatHelp: Only the container changes. Video, audio and supported subtitles keep their original codecs.
Journey.Export.MkvHelp: The most flexible choice for Panasonic recorder video. Saved as .mkv.
Journey.Export.MpegHelp: For originals already using MPEG-2 video and compatible audio and subtitles.
Journey.Export.Mp4Help: For compatible original codecs such as H.264 and AAC. MPEG-2 video cannot be copied into this app's MP4 output.
Journey.Export.CompatibilityHelp: Compatibility is checked before copying. If a stream does not fit, choose another container; there is no re-encoding or silent removal of media streams.
Journey.Export.DestinationHelp: Choose a folder on your PC or another drive.
Journey.Export.SpaceHelp: Actual sizes vary slightly by container. Available space and source-disk safety are checked before writing.
Journey.Export.ExistingFilesHelp: Existing files are kept. A number is added when a filename is already in use.
Journey.Export.VerificationHelp: Each completed file is checked for matching stream counts and codecs. Your recorder disk stays read only.
Journey.Export.MkvSummary: Create MKV copies with original video and audio. No quality lost through re-encoding.
Journey.Export.MpegSummary: Create .mpg copies from compatible MPEG-2 originals. No codec conversion is performed.
Journey.Export.Mp4Summary: Create .mp4 copies from compatible original streams. Choosing MP4 does not convert the video codec.
Journey.Export.InspectionCancelled: Export verified with ffprobe. MediaInfo inspection cancelled.
Journey.Archive.Title: A new chapter for your recordings.
Journey.Archive.Subtitle: Review the copies created this session. Keep them close, or add a copy in the cloud.
Journey.Archive.EmptyTitle: Your archive starts with one recording
Journey.Archive.EmptyHelp: Preserve a recording to see its completed copy here, along with its original and destination media details.
Journey.Archive.VerificationHelp: Review each file's verification and media details below. Downloads retain the delivered bytes; remuxed copies retain the compressed media streams.
Journey.Archive.SelectHelp: Check the copies you want to upload. Media details stay available for every original and completed file.
Journey.Archive.Compare: Compare source and saved file · MediaInfo
Journey.Cloud.Title: A copy in the cloud
Journey.Cloud.Help: Send checked copies directly to your own OneDrive. You decide when an upload begins.
Journey.Cloud.SetupHelp: Uploading needs a sign-in to OneDrive in Settings. The sign-in is saved and protected for your Windows account.
Journey.Cloud.Disconnected: OneDrive is not connected yet. Open Manage connection to sign in.
Journey.Cloud.SelectHelp: Check one or more preserved copies above to upload.
Journey.Cloud.SelectionRequired: Check at least one exported file to upload.
Journey.Cloud.ConnectHelp: Choose Connect OneDrive below and sign in with your Microsoft account. Then return to Archive and upload.
Journey.Archive.FolderUnavailable: This folder is no longer available.

Journey.Dlna.SelectInspect: Select a recording to download and inspect its delivered stream.
Journey.Dlna.ConnectHelp: Find a DLNA recorder on your local network. No USB disk removal is needed. Discovery starts only when you choose Find.
Journey.Dlna.DeviceRequired: Find and choose a network recorder first.
Journey.Dlna.Finding: Finding DLNA recorders on the local network…
Journey.Dlna.NoneFoundHelp: Check that the recorder is awake, DLNA is enabled, and both devices are on the same network.
Journey.Dlna.CatalogueHelp: Select a folder or recording. Only unprotected, non-converted HTTP resources are eligible; unknown conversion status is shown explicitly.
Journey.Dlna.LibrarySubtitle: Browse the recorder's DLNA catalogue and choose the delivered streams to keep.
Journey.Dlna.OriginalNotice: DLNA metadata is a server declaration. Even CI=0 does not independently prove that the served stream matches the recorder's original disk recording. Protected content and streams marked converted are not downloadable here.
Journey.Dlna.ListAccessible: DLNA recordings; unavailable and protected entries cannot be selected
Journey.Dlna.PreviewHelp: Preview first downloads the complete delivered stream into this session's temporary cache, then creates a short clip without re-encoding.
Journey.Dlna.DownloadNotice: A full download can take time and local disk space. The source is requested from the recorder without changing its catalogue. Cancel remains available.
Journey.Dlna.EmptyFolder: This folder is empty, or the recorder did not return any accessible entries.
Journey.Dlna.NoMatches: No titles match this filter. Clear it to see this folder again.
Journey.Dlna.StatusOriginal: Server declares non-converted (CI=0) · not independently verified
Journey.Dlna.StatusUnknown: Conversion status unknown · delivered stream can be saved unchanged
Journey.Dlna.StatusConverted: Server marks stream converted (CI=1) · unavailable for download
Journey.Dlna.SelectDownloadable: Select a downloadable recording to inspect.
Journey.Dlna.ExportTitle: Keep the stream your recorder delivers.
Journey.Dlna.ExportSubtitle: Save the received media bytes unchanged, or save them as one stream-copy container.
Journey.Dlna.ExportSelectHelp: Select one or more eligible network recordings first.
Journey.Dlna.UnchangedNotice: Untouched download means no re-encoding or remuxing by AMG DIGA Archive. It is not proof that the recorder itself served its disk-original stream. CI=1 and protected responses are rejected.
Journey.Dlna.TotalUnsupported: The recorder advertises a size total beyond supported disk limits. Refresh the catalogue or reduce the selection before downloading.
Journey.Dlna.RawInspectionPending: Delivered bytes saved. MediaInfo inspection pending.
Journey.Dlna.RemuxInspectionPending: Stream-copy container verified with FFprobe. MediaInfo inspection pending.
Journey.Dlna.RemuxVerification: FFprobe verified stream counts, codecs and duration against the delivered download, which was then removed. Its size and SHA-256 are in the source details. Recorder-original status remains unverified.
Journey.Dlna.RemuxInspectionCancelled: Stream-copy container verified with FFprobe. MediaInfo inspection was cancelled.
Journey.Dlna.SavedHelp: Delivered downloads are kept unchanged. Review their verification details in Archive.
Journey.Dlna.SavedContainerHelp: Each recording was saved as one stream-copy container. The delivered download was removed after the container was verified. Review the verification details in Archive.
Journey.Dlna.SavedContainerKeptHelp: At least one delivered download was kept next to its container. Archive shows the reason for each kept file.
Journey.Dlna.RemuxVerificationKept: FFprobe verified stream counts and codecs against the delivered download. The delivered download was kept as a separate file. Recorder-original status remains unverified.
Journey.Dlna.DeliveredKeptFailed: The container was not completed, so this delivered download was kept.
Journey.Dlna.DeliveredKeptDuration: The container's duration differs from this delivered download or could not be compared, so both files were kept.
Journey.Dlna.DeliveredKeptLocked: The container was verified, but this delivered download could not be removed. You can delete it yourself.
Journey.Dlna.PreviewSelectionRequired: Select a downloadable network recording first.
Journey.Dlna.RecordingSizeUnsupported: The recorder advertises an unsupported recording size. Refresh its catalogue before downloading a preview.
